{{Quote|The beasts for which the Star Destroyer was named were semi-aquatic predators that could be trained as formidable mounts. They fought on after their rider was dead—as did this vessel.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]]|<ref name="Ascension" />}}
The '''''Bloodfin''''' was a [[Turbulent-class Star Destroyer|''Turbulent''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] that began its service in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval forces]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in [[41 ABY]]. It was built to serve as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. By [[44 ABY]], the ship was commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Vitor Reige]] and [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]], who succeeded Pellaeon as leader of the Remnant after the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] came to an end.

==Description==
The ''Bloodfin'' was smaller in comparison with other [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] of the time. Despite its physical deviation from the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|traditional design]] of Star Destroyers, the vessel possessed a greater capacity for maneuverability. Although it was meant to perform as a "pocket destroyer," the ''Bloodfin'' still retained much of the impressive weaponry that could be found on the more common destroyers.<ref name="Revelation" />

==History==
The ''Bloodfin'' entered its first military engagement at the [[Second Battle of Fondor]] in [[41 ABY]]. When [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] refused to comply with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]]' orders to ignore the ceasefire and attack [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], [[Tahiri Veila]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] him with the support of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]], including [[Quille]] and [[Rosset]]. Although they ensured that the Remnant remained loyal to Caedus, the ''Bloodfin'' was boarded by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Protectors]], which then resulted in the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of most of the ship's crew.<ref name="Revelation" /> After the battle, the ''Bloodfin'' was added to [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Maw Irregular Fleet]], under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Vitor Reige]].<ref name="Invincible" /> After the [[Battle of Uroro Station|conclusion]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the ''Bloodfin'' returned to the service of the Imperial Remnant while still under Reige's command. In [[44 ABY]], it was part of a large task force that was led by [[Jagged Fel]] in a preemptive strike on Daala's insurrectionist fleet. During the [[Battle over Exodo II]], the destruction of the [[Gilad Pellaeon (starship)|''Gilad Pellaeon'']] forced Fel to transfer the status of [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] over to the ''Bloodfin'' as the fighting intensified between the Remnant armada and the Maw Irregular Fleet.<ref name="Ascension" />
